variants.title: Sharks and tides
variants.premise: Built from reviewer's opener and menu, with writer-b's refusals.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance of a boat out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Do I look like a ship to you?

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Someone else's boat, then?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Go and ask them. I know sharks and tides, that's the lot.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The fisher bites the twine off and starts again.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Rocks are that way. Fish are that way. Ships, no idea.

options.label: Would you take me for coin?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No, I wouldn't.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You'd be sick before the rocks.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Shark. Two of them.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is that good?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: It's two more than you've caught.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Aye. Mind the gulls.

variants.title: Stayed for the fish
variants.premise: Built from reviewer's post variant, with writer-a's parting line.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance of a boat out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The fisher looks up at the quiver on your back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Half this village came south to fight for one of those.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: And what about you?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I came for the fish.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Take that to the harbour in the capital. Not to me.

options.label: Who do I show it to?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Whoever keeps the ledger up there.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I've never been. Too far from the water.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: She's a fishing boat.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: What of it?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: So you'd smell of shark for a week.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Thought about it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then I thought about the fish.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't thank me. I did nothing.
